description_en: Creates sound code labels in batches for a specified schedule
description_zh: 调用该接口为指定排程批量创建声码标签

name: BatchCreateSoundCodeLabel

parameters.help_en: The number of sound codes to create in batches. Valid values: 1 to 200. The system automatically generates a label for each sound code that consists of a random combination of letters and digits
parameters.help_zh: 批量创建声码个数，数量为1～200个，系统将为每个声码自动生成由字母、数字随机组合的标签
